definition: far bigger than normal for its kind
description: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.
